parameters.description:
Relay a message to your own Fluxer by posting a native `fluxer` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`fluxer-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `fluxer` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Fluxer URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `webhook_id_secret` and `webhook_token_secret` parameters name the customer secrets holding this enrollment's Fluxer webhook id and token).
parameters.plus_base_url: ${ customer_secrets.FLUXER_BASE ?? https://api.fluxer.app }/webhooks/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_token_secret }} }

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's fluxer webhook id

webhook_token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's fluxer webhook token
